The '''Obulette system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Mecetti Province]], on the [[Procopian Shipping Lane]]. The system had at least six [[Planet/Legends|planets]] orbiting a single, cool dim red [[Star/Legends|star]]. The fourth planet, [[Obulette]], served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for [[House Mecetti]]. The [[Obulette shipyards]] orbited Obulette, consisted of two large docks and numerous smaller docks. Between the fifth and sixth planet was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]; House Mecetti used it as a defensive screen and seeded numerous [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="LE" />
